cartes: End of the wars against France (Napoleon): start of "The British Century"
The UK is the dominant world power
Colonial Office with a Secretary of State for the Colonies
Conquest of Australia and New Zealand
The conquest of India (begun in the 17th century) is complete
Sepoy Rebellion (Indian Mutiny, "First Indian war of independence")
Government of India Act: the East India Company is nationalised, the Crown takes over its powers
India Office; the Governor-General is renamed Viceroy
Benjamin Disraeli has Queen Victoria proclaimed Empress of India
Hong Kong becomes a British colony
British conquest of the Cape (South Africa)
Opening of the Suez Canal (controlled by France and Britain, way to India)
Berlin Congo Conference: European powers share the African continent
Boer War against Dutch settlers in South Africa
90% of Africa under European control; the British Empire reaches its zenith
"The Rhodes Colossus" cartoon in Punch (Cape-to-Cairo railway plans)
Britain controls 45% of the world's trade
Charles Darwin publishes On the Origin of Species
Empire Day is celebrated every year
The surface covered by the British Empire stops growing
Statute of Westminster: the dominions are granted a lot of autonomy
Independence of India (divided into Pakistan, India and Bangladesh)
Suez Crisis (the UK is no longer "the giant")
India agrees to become a member of the Commonwealth of Nations
The Commonwealth has 30 members (newly independent African countries)
